relations.name: reporting_borrower_matrix_plot_v1
relations.comment: R029 display-only coordinates: fixed 0-100 matrix, midpoint 50; high health left, contribution >=1x above. Modified schedules at x75 are categorical placement, not a changed payment score. V3 is unchanged. Padding affects rendering only; invalid inputs and Unclassified remain explicit.
relations.view_definition:
WITH inputs AS (
         SELECT m.borrower_id,
            m.contribution_30d,
            m.active_borrower_count,
            m.portfolio_contribution_30d,
            m.contribution_share,
            m.equal_share,
            m.relative_contribution,
            m.reliability_score,
            m.confidence,
            m.quadrant,
            m.classification_reason,
            m.outstanding_principal,
            m.reporting_date,
            m.calculated_at,
            m.method_version,
            m.payment_only_quadrant,
            m.arrangement_status,
            m.arrangement_gate,
            m.modified_schedule_loan_count,
            m.interest_coverage_30d,
            m.interest_date_coverage_30d,
            m.category_adjusted,
                CASE
                    WHEN m.quadrant = 'Unclassified'::text THEN 'Unclassified'::text
                    WHEN (m.quadrant <> ALL (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text, 'Question Mark'::text, 'Dog'::text])) OR m.reliability_score IS NULL OR m.reliability_score < 0::numeric OR m.reliability_score > 100::numeric OR m.relative_contribution IS NULL OR (m.relative_contribution::text = ANY (ARRAY['NaN'::text, 'Infinity'::text, '-Infinity'::text])) OR m.arrangement_gate IS NULL THEN 'Invalid plot input'::text
                    WHEN (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text])) <> (m.reliability_score >= 80::numeric AND NOT m.arrangement_gate) OR (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Question Mark'::text])) <> (m.relative_contribution >= 1::numeric) THEN 'Invalid plot input'::text
                    ELSE 'Plotted'::text
                END AS plot_status
           FROM reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m
        ), coordinates AS (
         SELECT i.borrower_id,
            i.contribution_30d,
            i.active_borrower_count,
            i.portfolio_contribution_30d,
            i.contribution_share,
            i.equal_share,
            i.relative_contribution,
            i.reliability_score,
            i.confidence,
            i.quadrant,
            i.classification_reason,
            i.outstanding_principal,
            i.reporting_date,
            i.calculated_at,
            i.method_version,
            i.payment_only_quadrant,
            i.arrangement_status,
            i.arrangement_gate,
            i.modified_schedule_loan_count,
            i.interest_coverage_30d,
            i.interest_date_coverage_30d,
            i.category_adjusted,
            i.plot_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN i.plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.arrangement_gate THEN 75::numeric
                        WHEN i.reliability_score < 80::numeric THEN 100::numeric - 50::numeric * i.reliability_score / 80::numeric
                        ELSE 50::numeric - 50::numeric * (i.reliability_score - 80::numeric) / 20::numeric
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS matrix_x,
                CASE
                    WHEN i.plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.relative_contribution < 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                        ELSE 100::numeric * i.relative_contribution / (1::numeric + i.relative_contribution)
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS matrix_y
           FROM inputs i
        )
 SELECT borrower_id,
    contribution_30d,
    active_borrower_count,
    portfolio_contribution_30d,
    contribution_share,
    equal_share,
    relative_contribution,
    reliability_score,
    confidence,
    quadrant,
    classification_reason,
    outstanding_principal,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    method_version,
    payment_only_quadrant,
    arrangement_status,
    arrangement_gate,
    modified_schedule_loan_count,
    interest_coverage_30d,
    interest_date_coverage_30d,
    category_adjusted,
    plot_status,
    matrix_x,
    matrix_y,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text]) THEN GREATEST(2::numeric, LEAST(49.5, matrix_x))
                ELSE GREATEST(50.5, LEAST(98::numeric, matrix_x))
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS plot_x,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Question Mark'::text]) THEN GREATEST(50.5, LEAST(98::numeric, matrix_y))
                ELSE GREATEST(2::numeric, LEAST(49.5, matrix_y))
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS plot_y,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status <> 'Plotted'::text THEN plot_status
            WHEN arrangement_gate THEN 'Modified-schedule category placement'::text
            ELSE 'Measured score'::text
        END AS position_basis,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN relative_contribution < 0::numeric
            ELSE false
        END AS contribution_clipped,
    'bcg-display-v1'::text AS plot_method_version
   FROM coordinates c;
